resources.string: Indoors GPS is weak or wrong. Import a floor plan of the building (a photo, an image or a PDF page from the architect or the fire-escape plan), one per floor. During an indoor session you then tap on the plan where you are at every turn, door or landmark, and Manete places the measurements in between along your path. Plans stay on this phone.
Not used in a session yet
The plan and its image are removed from this phone. A plan used in a session cannot be deleted: delete those sessions first.
%1$s is used in a session, so it stays: its positions would be lost. Delete those sessions first.
E.g. “2nd floor” or “B1”; shown when you switch floors.
This file is not an image or PDF that Android can read. Use PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC or PDF; export CAD drawings to PDF or PNG first.
The file could not be read. Try copying it to the phone first.
This PDF is password-protected. Save it without a password, or take a screenshot of the plan.
The image is too large for this phone\'s memory. Make it smaller first (e.g. a screenshot of the floor).
The plan could not be saved. Is the phone\'s storage full?

Optional: with the plan placed on the map, indoor positions are also exported as latitude/longitude. Tap a point on the plan, then the same point on the map (e.g. a building corner), and repeat for a second point far from the first. A third point checks the placement. Zoom the map in far enough to see the building.
Point %1$s: tap it on the plan or on the map.
Point %1$s: now tap it on the plan.
Point %1$s: now tap it on the map.
The points are too close together: choose points far apart.
Placed: plan turned %1$s° from north, 1 m = %2$s px
; the points are off by %1$s m on average (re-place one if this is large).

Tap two points whose real distance you know, as far apart as possible (a long wall or corridor), then enter that distance. Pinch to zoom, drag to move, double-tap to see the whole plan. The scale is optional: with it, positions are also exported in metres.
Both points set. Tap again to start over.
Saved scale: 1 m = %1$s px. Set new points to change it.
The points are too close together: choose two points further apart.
This floor plan no longer exists.
